---
name: aws-deployment
description: Plan and implement secure AWS deployments using containers, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and AWS managed services.
---

# AWS Deployment Skill

- Inspect the current deployment architecture first.
- Follow existing AWS account, region, IAM, networking, and naming conventions.
- Prefer least-privilege IAM.
- Never hardcode credentials.
- Use approved secret management.
- Consider Docker image lifecycle and registry security.
- Consider Kubernetes rollout, health checks, resources, and rollback.
- Consider CI/CD failure handling and artifact traceability.
- Include observability and operational considerations.
- Identify potentially destructive infrastructure changes before execution.
